name: Amazon Bedrock
desc: AWS managed service for foundation models with agents and RAG
desc_zh: AWS 托管的基础模型服务，内置智能体与 RAG 能力
solves: Model choice, the guardrails and the audit trail are three separate purchases. Bedrock keeps them in one AWS account your security team already reviews.
solves_zh: 选模型、加护栏、留审计记录是三笔独立采购。Bedrock 把它们收在一个 AWS 账号里，安全团队本来就在审这个账号。
best_for: When procurement wants one vendor and one compliance story behind your model calls.
best_for_zh: 当采购希望模型调用背后只有一家供应商、一套合规说法时。
